forum.title: STM32G0B1KCT6 how to use dual bank as single bank to use full 256KB.
forum.best_answer_content:
The IAR IDE flasher used by the for flashing the MCU via debugger used the below attached files and spec that defines the banks separately and does not allow write over bank2.

![Sneha_0-1776331759860.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/835a33bd-4dc0-d3ab-e332-3a51215227d0.png "Sneha_0-1776331759860.png")

These files are now modified with full memory usage for the given MCU., which now allows writing into BANK2.

![Sneha_1-1776332030780.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8f36d181-b84e-df11-334d-7b3f2917504d.png "Sneha_1-1776332030780.png")![Sneha_2-1776332070912.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/adea1e99-160c-16c8-eccf-9eca47150c5d.png "Sneha_2-1776332070912.png")![Sneha_3-1776332109911.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a1ca3b18-c858-938d-1520-6be97f277d65.png "Sneha_3-1776332109911.png")

Regards,

Sneha
